facts.statement_en: Systematic review and pairwise meta-analysis of intervention studies.
Adults undergoing percutaneous cardiac or cardiac device procedures; non-fasting versus conventional fasting; patient comfort and safety.
Eligibility is specified in the accepted protocol; final-review methods are identified separately.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: ELIGIBILITY; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Include randomized controlled trials comparing non-fasting with fasting before percutaneous cardiac or cardiac device procedures. Collect the Review-defined satisfaction, symptom and safety outcomes using participant counts for binary outcomes or reported means, standard deviations and group sizes for continuous outcomes.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: SELECTION_PROCESS; method_basis: FINAL_REVIEW_METHOD; description: Two authors independently evaluated retrieved records, two authors reviewed full texts, and disagreements were resolved by consensus after consultation.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: DATA_COLLECTION; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Two reviewers will independently extract data using a standardized Microsoft Excel form. Fields will include study design and country, anesthesia modality, fasting and non-fasting protocols, fasting duration, procedure type, primary endpoints, participant numbers and baseline characteristics, and all eligible outcomes. Disagreements will be resolved by a senior reviewer.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: RISK_OF_BIAS; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Two reviewers will independently assess randomized trials using Cochrane RoB 2 across the randomization process, deviations from intended interventions, missing outcome data, outcome measurement, selection of reported results, and overall bias. Disagreements will be resolved with a senior reviewer.
status: REPORTED; method_domain: EFFECT_MEASURE; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: The review used risk ratio, mean difference.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: SYNTHESIS_MODEL; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: All Target meta-analyses will use a random-effects model selected before inspecting Study effect estimates, Q, or I² because the eligible Review combines different cardiac procedure types, anesthesia modalities, fasting protocols, and trial-reported outcome definitions.

status: REPORTED; method_domain: HETEROGENEITY; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: All Target meta-analyses will use a random-effects model selected before inspecting Study effect estimates, Q, or I² because the eligible Review combines different cardiac procedure types, anesthesia modalities, fasting protocols, and trial-reported outcome definitions. Cochran's Q and I² will describe observed heterogeneity but will not select or change the analysis model. A chi-square P value below 0.10 will indicate significant heterogeneity. I² values of 0% to 40% will be considered low, 30% to 60% moderate, 50% to 90% substantial, and 75% to 100% considerable heterogeneity.
status: REPORTED; method_domain: SUBGROUP; method_basis: PRESPECIFIED_PROTOCOL; description: Subgroup analyses will be conducted where sufficient data are available.
